scope: Known high-value Prometeo lines surfaced by the current recovery effort plus currently registered Agent Runtime workstreams. This is not a claim of enumerating every historical ChatGPT conversation in the account.

important_lines.note: R01-R10 have durable returns or explicit owner absorption; residual branches are integrated or deliberately accounted by policy.
Recovered from max-length chat; future work must use contracts/current Git rather than redesign settled behavior.
Previously analyzed but not persisted; now durably registered. Stable served app and protected custom-voice candidate remain intentionally distinct until exact comparison.
Private runtime truth must be reverified from Supabase when needed; public coordination never reconstructs financial/private facts from chat.
R10 recovery was absorbed by this existing product owner; remaining microphone/device/human-acceptance frontier is product work, not historical recovery debt.
Coordination/runtime owner. Existing unaware chats cannot be retroactively injected with a command, but new/recovered durable work no longer requires manual giant-prompt transport.

orphan_definition: An important line is an orphan when its only usable continuation state exists in an inaccessible/exhausted chat and no current owner, workstream, recovery digest, durable source/contract or explicit retained frontier tells a fresh agent how to continue without redesigning it.
important_limitations: Prometeo/GitHub cannot enumerate every historical ChatGPT conversation in the user's account, so this audit is exhaustive only for the known targeted recovery set and registered runtime surfaces inspected here.
If another exhausted chat is later surfaced and contains unique work with no durable artifact, it must be routed/metabolized before being treated as safely recoverable.
CHAT_ONLY_UNKNOWN information that never produced any accessible artifact cannot be reconstructed honestly.
continuity_rule: Before substantial work on a surfaced old line, route to an existing owner/workstream first.
If the old chat contains unique decisions or negative knowledge, persist a sanitized RECOVERY/LAST_RETURN rather than a raw public transcript.
Separate SERVED, CURRENT, HUMAN_ACCEPTED, CANDIDATE, HISTORICAL, REJECTED and UNRESOLVED states.
Persist material progress before reporting completion so the worker chat itself can disappear.
Never ask the human to transport recoverable context between Prometeo-aware chats.
next_audit_trigger: Run an incremental orphan audit whenever the human surfaces another max-length/dead chat or when a significant product exists outside registered runtime ownership. Do not periodically recreate this audit merely for ceremony.
